The compilation fails because the updated dependency (commons-io 20030203.000550) no longer provides org.apache.commons.io.output.ThresholdingOutputStream, and also removed the commons-io ByteArrayOutputStream class (which provided toInputStream()). The client class currently extends ThresholdingOutputStream and overrides its methods; with the class gone, the import, inheritance, and overrides break. To fix this, we will:
- Remove the import and inheritance of ThresholdingOutputStream, and instead extend java.io.OutputStream.
- Reimplement the thresholding behavior locally: track written bytes, and once the threshold is exceeded, switch from an in-memory ByteArrayOutputStream to a file OutputStream.
- Implement write(int), write(byte[],int,int), write(byte[]), flush(), and adjust close().
- Replace usage of memoryOutputStream.toInputStream() (commons-io feature) with new ByteArrayInputStream(memoryOutputStream.toByteArray()).
- Add imports for java.io.ByteArrayInputStream and java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream.
- Remove @Override on methods that no longer override supertype methods (getStream, thresholdReached), but keep @Override for close/flush/write which override OutputStream methods.
These minimal edits will keep functionality consistent and restore compilation.
</think>
